qpqs.note: dtPS = t*_P - t*_S (from ln(P/S) slope); slope vs T_S = 1/(1.78 Qp) - 1/Qs (path-average, site kappa differences add scatter)

verdict: No robust source-side secondary phase (SmS, PmS, PmP, SmP from below; Sp, Ps from above) in the long-term LFE stacks of 27 families: no hypothesis reaches z >= 3 with the within-depth-class null while being consistent in boreholes, surface stations and odd/even families. Injections: an SmS copy of >= ~0.3 x direct S would have been detected (z 4-6). Attenuation (dt*_S, dt*_P, P/S) unchanged at all quakes, restart and long-term.
